sourceFile: 30. TIU C11-20  Report Test Frame damage mesh 2026.04.10. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor and measurement grouping are not reliable enough for Ask AI.
issues: Changed factor should be Frame Test Type 1/2/3 vs Normal, not Day shift as a condition.
Frame Test Type 1 is incorrectly treated as subgroup context.
Function-defect results are valid but need inherited date/shift/model context handled consistently.
RAW DATA SPL/THD measurement outcomes are auto-extracted and not tied to the same comparison cleanly.
Review title and metric labels are noisy extracted row text.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as frame test type comparison with Normal baseline.
Move date, day shift, model, and lot size to subgroup/context fields.
Keep function-defect outcome from Test rows 15, 17, 19, and 21 with corrected rates.
Exclude or clearly separate unjudged RAW DATA SPL/THD soundcheck tables unless condition mapping is proven.
Replace noisy title and metrics with concise report-level labels.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations support only corrected function-result evidence, not the generated measurement grouping.
